entities.summary: Tatsuya Naka (b. 1964-05-29, Tokyo City) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tokyo City and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
